Name: Backside Attack
Author: ReddoHoku
Description:
[b]BETA[/b]

Enhance multiplayer co-op gameplay by enabling players to strike each other with various tools. Hits induce comical effects such as triggering emotes, dismounting riders, random warps, and swimsuit toggling. Friendly hits do not decrease health or work in the mines. 

This mod will only work in remote co-op if at least two players install it.
This mod works in local co-op.

This mod is still in Beta.

[b]Features[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Sword/Melee Weapon/Scythe
- Knock players off horse
- Cause other players to emote surprise
[*]Pickaxe
-  Change the other players into their swimsuits - they will revert back to normal in five seconds
[*]Watering Can
- Warp the other players next to a random NPC with 2+ hearts.
- Warp the player to the middle of town, If the player does not have any relationships with 2+ hearts.
[*]Hoe
- Warp the other players either to the hospital, town, or smithy.
[/list]
[b]Install
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/b]

Downloads.Description: Unzip, and place folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
